classes.name: Z-drug hypnotics
classes.description: Zolpidem IR/ER/SL (Ambien, Ambien CR, Edluar), eszopiclone (Lunesta), zaleplon; ramelteon (Rozerem) and low-dose doxepin (Silenor) may be listed as alternatives.

classes.name: Benzodiazepines and buspirone for anxiety

classes.plainDescription: A medicine for anxiety or panic attacks.

records.preferredRestriction: Step therapy (p.66): for generalized or social anxiety, trial with an SSRI or SNRI before the first benzodiazepine; for panic disorder, concurrent antidepressant therapy required. Duration limits (p.66): 30 consecutive days for insomnia, 90 consecutive days for panic disorder. PA required for initiation in patients on opioid or buprenorphine therapy; PA for any additional benzodiazepine prescription in patients already on one; PA when more than a 14-day supply is prescribed to a patient on a CNS stimulant (p.66).
